question.text: Performance fee can be charged only after:

answer.text: Applying High Water Mark (HWM) and Hurdle Rate (where applicable)

explanation.text: The Logic: Performance fees are charged only on NEW profits above HWM, and only after clearing the hurdle rate. Both mechanisms protect clients from paying twice. The Trap: Charging monthly without HWM would double-charge clients. Cross-Exam Context: Core XXI-A/B content. Manager's Pro-Tip: Document the HWM calculation methodology in the DD — ambiguity has caused SEBI enforcement actions.
